latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor — Initial Release

- Instantly edit and export 1080p AI-enhanced videos from raw footage by simply describing your needs—no timeline editing required.
- Automatic session setup and free token generation for new users.
- Supports prompt-based workflows: upload, edit, preview timeline, and export, all via chat.
- Cloud rendering pipeline with live status updates and error handling (token, credits, supported formats).
- Handles video, audio, and image uploads in common formats up to 500MB.
- Clear mapping of user prompts to editing actions for streamlined experience.
